title: Focal loss
summary: Binary and multi-class focal loss with gamma and alpha, from logits and without overflow, plus the binary gradient.

paper.title: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection

mutants.alpha_not_flipped: Uses alpha for every example, not 1 - alpha for the negative examples.
mutants.grad_missing_focal_term: Treats (1 - p_t)^gamma as a constant in the gradient and drops the gamma p_t log p_t term.
mutants.multiclass_ignores_alpha: Ignores the per-class alpha in the multi-class loss.
mutants.naive_log: Computes log p_t as log of sigmoid, so a logit of minus 1000 gives an infinite loss.
mutants.sum_not_mean: Sums the example losses and gradients and does not divide by N.
mutants.weight_pt_not_one_minus: Weights each term by p_t^gamma, not (1 - p_t)^gamma.
